name: context7
description: context7 (upstash/context7, MIT) — version-specific library docs into the agent context. OPT-IN / HOSTED: the local server is a thin client of the Context7 hosted API (queries leave your machine). net default-deny: only context7.com + mcp.context7.com. BYOK: CONTEXT7_API_KEY from the Keychain (optional; anonymous is rate-limited). Runtime dep: npx @upstash/context7-mcp (or set CONTEXT7_MCP_BIN).
